cover.sub: 5 niche things that will make you
cover.title: dangerously good at the data act

inner.title: it already applies
inner.body: the data act has applied across the eu since 12 september 2025, per the european commission. if your contracts still say coming soon, you're a year late.
inner.label: since 2025

inner.title: two months notice
inner.body: cloud and saas contracts must let customers start switching with at most two months notice. that includes your customers leaving you.
inner.label: lock-in's over

inner.title: egress fees end
inner.body: from 12 january 2027, providers must drop switching charges, including egress fees. until then they can still bill switching costs, so check invoices.

inner.title: the data is theirs
inner.body: users of connected products can access the data they generate, free of charge. you can't even use their non-personal data without an agreement.
inner.label: not your data

inner.title: unfair terms die
inner.body: take-it-or-leave-it terms imposed by a stronger party can be unfair and stop being valid. a clause dodging liability for gross negligence always is.
inner.label: read the msa

closer.HEADLINE:
not compliance.
it's leverage.
